text:
Maria Chen (AE): Heads-up — AlderBank POC kicks off tomorrow. They want a nearly drop-in replacement for OrbitAI’s API for chat+generate. Main asks: prompt parity, streaming behavior, function-calling compat, and clear pricing mapping. Need checklist + owners.
Devon Patel (Eng): Got it. Do we have a sample OrbitAI request/response they expect? streaming vs non-streaming differences?
Maria Chen (AE): They pasted this example from Orbit docs:
```
curl -X POST https://api.orbitai.com/v1/chat/generate 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer ORBIT_KEY' 
 -d '{"model":"gpt-3x","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize Q1"}],"stream":true,"stop":["\n\n"]}'
```
They expect same chunking and stop behavior. Also want identical role names and metadata header `x-orbit-session-id`.
Jamie Ortiz (Solutions): Suggestion: implement a lightweight proxy shim that rewrites headers + request body to our API and re-streams chunks in Orbit-compatible deltas. Easier than changing client. Can validate with our streaming test harness.
Devon Patel (Eng): Proxy shim is fine. Need to confirm: Orbit’s stream uses token-delta frames and closes with `event: done` — do we replicate exactly? we can emulate but need to map our internal chunking. Also need to ensure KV cache warm-up doesn't change first-response latency.
Jamie Ortiz (Solutions): Yes, emulate `event: delta` / `event: done`. We should include a compatibility mode flag so we can toggle strict vs lenient parity for edge cases.
Priya Singh (Sales Ops): Pricing question from AlderBank finance: they bill customers per API call on Orbit (flat per-call fee + egress). How do we present Redwood pricing to make comparisons straightforward?
Devon Patel (Eng): Two parts: per-token accounting (what we report) and per-call invoice mapping. We can surface a synthetic "call unit" metric in Console that maps tokens + average latency to an equivalent per-call fee for the POC.
Priya Singh (Sales Ops): Can we provide a sample pricing comparison sheet by EOD? customer expects delta against Orbit for 500k tokens/month.
Maria Chen (AE): Please. AlderBank procurement will want a 30-day POC with an option to commit to Dedicated. Also SSO + IP allowlist required.
Oliver Wu (Security): I'll need the data flow diagram and whether customer data is persisted in any centralized logs. If proxy retains Orbit headers, ensure we strip any PII. Also need to know KMS usage for their keys.
Maria Chen (AE): They want to keep session IDs for analytics but redact user identifiers.
Oliver Wu (Security): Acceptable if we store session_id only and redact user PII. I'll fill out the security questionnaire — need access to the Orbit API example payloads + any sample logs that would be forwarded to us.
Devon Patel (Eng): Action items I propose:
- devon: build proxy shim PoC (container) that accepts Orbit headers and forwards to /v1/chat with compatibility flag.
- jamie: write test plan for stream parity (token ordering, event types, stop sequences).
- oliver: complete security questionnaire + run quick privacy gating.
- priya: pricing comparison draft.
- maria: coordinate customer schedule + SSO details.
Can we have initial PoC container by EOD tomorrow?
Jamie Ortiz (Solutions): I can mock the Orbit client behavior and run smoke tests. Will post curl examples. :rocket:
Maria Chen (AE): Great — please also add an example of mapping error codes (Orbit 429 -> our 429 with X-RateInfo header). They specifically call out rate-limit semantics.
Devon Patel (Eng): Noted. Quick mapping snippet I'll test:
```
# proxy mapping pseudocode
if orbit_response.status == 429:
  return 429, { 'X-RateInfo': orbit_response.headers['Retry-After'] }
else:
  return 200, orbit_response.body
```
Jamie Ortiz (Solutions): Also: function-calling differences — Orbit includes `function_call` in the delta stream. We should forward our `tool_call` events as-is but rename to `function_call` in the shim to avoid client changes.
Oliver Wu (Security): For the questionnaire — they asked about data residency in EU. Are we serving from eu-central?
Devon Patel (Eng): Hosted API has eu-central region for this customer. We'll ensure the proxy containers run in that region for POC.
Priya Singh (Sales Ops): I'll draft a short addendum about SLA for the POC and a one-page cost delta. Will also include a clause for canary rollback if parity regressions hit.
Maria Chen (AE): Perfect. Can everyone drop quick status updates in this thread by 5pm PT? I'll present the checklist to AlderBank close-of-day.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: compatibility-proxy-poc -> eu-central deploy tomorrow 09:00 UTC (manual approval required)
Jamie Ortiz (Solutions): I'll add the approval link when it's up.
Devon Patel (Eng): Starting work now. Will ping when container image is ready for smoke tests.
Oliver Wu (Security): I'll start the questionnaire and ping infra for region confirmation.
Priya Singh (Sales Ops): Pricing sheet draft inbound 3pm PT.
Maria Chen (AE): Thanks team — keeping this thread as single source of truth. :thumbsup:
